{
  "participants": [
    {
      "login": "hodlinator",
      "stance": "support",
      "note": "Concept ACK; reviewed template usage, compilation impact, and suggested various code and script cleanups"
    },
    {
      "login": "l0rinc",
      "stance": "support",
      "note": "Concept ACK for compile-time enforcement of settings"
    },
    {
      "login": "Pitan1993",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "note": "changes-requested review quoting a single CI log line without explanation"
    },
    {
      "login": "maflcko",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "note": "suggested improvements to DefaultFn, HelpFn extensibility, and removing IsArgSet uses"
    },
    {
      "login": "yancyribbens",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "note": "pointed out a typo in a comment"
    },
    {
      "login": "jeanpablojp",
      "stance": "objection",
      "note": "Concept ACK after testing, but raised objections regarding missing help text, silent behavior changes with null values, and linter gaps"
    }
  ],
  "claims": [
    {
      "id": "rc:1850653892",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "maintenance",
      "text": "non-constexpr static variables duplicated across compilation units causing redundant allocations",
      "quote": "these other non-constexpr statics seem like they end up being \"file-local\" static vars in every compilation unit that includes them. Seems off?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author switched to constexpr string literal types",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:1854744728"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:1854744728",
      "status_by_quote": "Good catch. I wanted to avoid changing these to keep the commit move-only as much as possible but it doesn't make sense"
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3825583400",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "help text sentence for BlockFilterIndexSetting is omitted in the generated help",
      "quote": "This sentence disappears from the generated help, BlockFilterIndexSetting keeps only the strprintf format string. It still describes what the code does.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "open",
      "status_note": "",
      "author_replies": [],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "",
      "status_by_quote": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3825583409",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "null elements in settings.json arrays are silently dropped instead of triggering a type error as on master",
      "quote": "A null element gets dropped silently here, and numbers now get converted, where the old GetArgs() threw... Raising it because the commit says behavior doesn't change.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "open",
      "status_note": "",
      "author_replies": [],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "",
      "status_by_quote": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3825583413",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "question",
      "kind": "scope",
      "text": "whether the parser regex should match templated GetArg<T> calls to migrate the five remaining settings",
      "quote": "This one is still read through args.GetArg<int32_t>(\"-prevoutfetchthreads\"), but was generated as common::Unset. The script's regex matches GetArg( but not GetArg<T>(. Five in total... Nothing breaks,",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "open",
      "status_note": "",
      "author_replies": [],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "",
      "status_by_quote": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3825583419",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "check-doc linter misses ProxySettingStr::Get and ::Value calls, allowing mismatched setting names to pass unnoticed",
      "quote": "This only matches ::Get on identifiers ending in Setting, so it misses ProxySettingStr::Get and ::Value calls like CJdnsReachableSetting::Value in init.cpp.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "open",
      "status_note": "",
      "author_replies": [],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "",
      "status_by_quote": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3861455984",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "maintenance",
      "text": "remove SettingTo/SettingToString/SettingToBool function overloads to eliminate the need for GetPtr()",
      "quote": "preferable to remove the overloads and thereby remove the need for GetPtr()",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "accepted",
      "status_note": "hodlinator moved this cleanup to separate PR #36295",
      "author_replies": [],
      "other_replies": [
        "rc:4039165525",
        "rc:4046676581"
      ],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4046676581",
      "status_by_quote": "Published: #36295"
    }
  ],
  "support": [
    {
      "id": "r:2492047895",
      "verdict": "Concept ACK",
      "reason": "it's a lot better to have the compiler do the job for us",
      "substantive": true,
      "evidence": "read",
      "areas": []
    },
    {
      "id": "r:2960951696",
      "verdict": "Concept ACK",
      "reason": "No (intended) changes in behavior when executing the code, just installing compile time guardrails",
      "substantive": true,
      "evidence": "read",
      "areas": []
    },
    {
      "id": "r:4987649380",
      "verdict": "Concept ACK",
      "reason": "Ran the script from the scripted diff, then built and ran the tests",
      "substantive": true,
      "evidence": "tested",
      "areas": []
    }
  ],
  "waiting_on": [
    {
      "on": "author",
      "what": "respond to jeanpablojp's review comments regarding missing help text, null handling in settings.json, and linter gaps",
      "id": "r:4987649380"
    }
  ],
  "notes": "Re-checked claims under schema 2: changed rc:3825583413 from objection to question as it states nothing breaks and asks if the omission was intentional. Added hodlinator's suggestion rc:3861455984 regarding removing overloads, which was accepted and extracted into PR #36295."
}
